services_in_studio.name: Hot Stone Ritual (Swedish 90min + Hot Stones + Foot 30min)

services_mobile_note: Mobile / in-room visits also offered citywide with a travel fee (Booksy lists Swedish from $178.20 and Deep Tissue from $198-270 for mobile, plus a $50-70 travel fee). Not itemized on the site to avoid clutter; site mentions the option and directs to IG/Booksy for a quote.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.body: My masseuse, Bea, was absolutely wonderful. She took the time to listen to where I was holding tension and delivered a custom, incredibly therapeutic massage. Her technique and attention to detail were top-tier. I walked out feeling completely refreshed and stress-free.

reviews.author: Giovanny
reviews.body: I was looking for a therapeutic massage in Downtown Miami and came across Calmare. From start to finish, the experience was excellent. Before the session began, Bea, the Licensed Massage Therapist, took the time to ask about my pain and areas of discomfort, then completely customized the treatment to meet my needs. The space was spotless, peaceful, and highly professional. If you're looking for a high-quality massage in Miami with personalized care, I highly recommend Calmare.

reviews.author: 1980leendert
reviews.body: In a busy city like Miami, finding a place where you immediately feel welcome and genuinely cared for is rare. From the moment I arrived, I knew I was in great hands. The atmosphere is peaceful, every detail is thoughtfully designed, and the entire experience was incredibly relaxing. CALMARE is a hidden gem, and I'll definitely come back every time I'm in Miami. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Pablo
reviews.body: Un espacio privado, limpio y muy cómodo. Me sentí relajado desde que llegué. La masajista muy amable y profesional. Sin dudas volveré en mi próxima visita a Miami.

reviews.author: Jamie
reviews.note: short review, not used as a full quote on site but counted toward the 5.0 x 30 aggregate

reviews.author: Jorge
reviews.body: I've enjoyed a most relaxing massage experience, the premises are neat and clean, the services are rendered in a very professional and experienced manner. I highly recommend it.
